steps.action: On the existing F-host only run docs/chatgpt_status/topography/shards/height_difference_2/automation/030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1; preserve or start exactly one persistent canonical daemon and never create a second runner.
Verify the four required recovery/output receipts, persistent_daemon_count_after=1, fresh heartbeat, and exact task/attempt/continuation claim before canonical numeric work.

Query the official National_LIDAR_Programme_Catalogues and LIDAR DTM Time Stamped catalogue services for each native EPSG:27700 target geometry; accept only exact intersecting returned features and capture survey id/file name, first/last flown dates, spacing/resolution, transform, geoid, phase/latest state.

Resolve the current HMLR INSPIRE polygon for IDs 46058185, 39866294 and 62045430 from the July 2026 monthly data, keep geometry in EPSG:27700, and require target point-inside-polygon before elevation sampling.

Use an XML-capable client against the persistent EA Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 endpoint; record the real CoverageId from GetCapabilities, run DescribeCoverage, then request actual coverage bytes for bounded native HMLR polygons.
Exclude NoData and compute median, q1, q3, min and max from actual EA DTM1m pixels inside each accepted polygon only; do not use WMS imagery, service-level min/max or centroid fallback.

Download actual OS Terrain 50 grid archives for TQ39, TQ59 and TQ27; require the real ASCII grid plus Metadata_<tile>.xml, sample documented 50m pixel centres, and read EPSG:27700, EPSG:5701/ODN and earliest/latest flying dates from per-tile metadata.
Run the three EA-primary versus OS-Terrain50-secondary numeric crosschecks. Keep EA survey/dataset RMSE and OS 4m product RMSE as quality-scope metadata only, never parcel confidence.

Perform human review and port 8012 readback; mark manual action RESOLVED only when all four F-host receipts, fresh heartbeat/claim, exact target lineage, accepted bytes and output acceptance are remotely verified.
